directory: served by the API; the offline bundle carries copies

legend.vv: Sigma0 VV in decibels, contrast-stretched between the percentiles above
legend.vh: Sigma0 VH in decibels, contrast-stretched between the percentiles above
legend.prediction: predicted oil at the case threshold, in amber
legend.probability: predicted oil probability before thresholding; blue is low, amber is around the usual operating point, white is near-certain
legend.comparison: green where prediction and reference agree, amber where the model predicted oil the reference does not mark, blue where the reference marks oil the model missed

label: Satellite imagery: Supplied Sentinel-1 SAR dataset
